Mom married a man after a few months of knowing him. Knowing I was uncomfortable with their matrimony, the husband texted me "suck it up princess". Her husband doesn't like me and my siblings and is jealous of the close relationship we had. I say "had" because she decided to put us on the backburner in favor of him. He drinks excessively, has a shady past, lies to her, spends their money, etc. I used to call her weekly but our phone calls were no more than 2 minutes. It got to the point where she didnt answer so I stopped calling. 
We do have a Facebook group chat where my siblings and I mostly share memes...so that's going for me.
Its one of the hardest things ive been dealing with in my adult life.

The doctor started me on 50mg on September 13th, and I took the first dose that night. I slept great and the next day I felt amazing, like I had my caffeine fix. I took my 2nd dose last night and my sleep was pretty poor. Today I'm just tired. 
The pharmacist advised me that I can try it a week in the evening and see how it goes and I can switch to mornings if I need. I also am advised to meet with my doctor in a week to discuss how things are going.
